selected_pilot_for_context.why_follow_up: A 16-point own-initial clean-completion gain with shorter flights, accompanied by a restricted-area cost. Check repeatability before treating this as a candidate.

audit.structural_probe: Synthetic bounded inputs verify computation dependencies; these are not performance scenarios.

curve.limitations: One training seed; paired development worlds. Bootstrap bands describe scenario variation, not training-seed uncertainty.
curve.checkpoint_reuse: Reuse requires exact full policy tensors, live experience, action/support settings and evaluation source. Untrained references may differ only in unused training reward transformations; learned points must match those too.

limitations: The recipe was selected after observing a pilot. The original seed 51700 is reported separately and excluded from the primary three-seed aggregate.
Twenty reused development worlds measure training-seed repeatability, not unseen-scenario generalization.
Same source, action support, full initial tensors and gSDE weight std within each seed; only resampling frequency differs.
The timing intervention changes both temporal action correlation and the optimizer response through the fixed KL stopping rule.
Both heading and speed noise timing change; their separate contributions are not isolated.
100k live transitions per run is a screening budget, not a convergence claim.
The prior pilot failed the restricted-area criterion. This follow-up does not waive that failure or declare a safe/competitive system.
Fixed route guidance and static filtering remain present. Aircraft-conflict filtering remains off.
Reserved streams20301/20302 and the official stream42 remain untouched.
One original attempt ended at 13481 live transitions during confirmed local sleep/hibernate. It is preserved and excluded from full-budget performance estimates.
The remaining four runs use a four-hour wall guard instead of one hour; learning settings, live budgets, source and scenario streams remain fixed.
This is a documented recovery amendment to an already running study; all seven attempts, including the incomplete one, must be reported.

recovery_amendment.reason: Confirmed Windows sleep/hibernate caused the 3600-second wall limit to expire at 13481 live transitions. The coordinator exited with code 1; the partial checkpoint passed its audit.
recovery_amendment.restart_policy: Restart the incomplete seed/arm from its original initialization in a new directory, then finish the remaining planned arms. Do not resume or overwrite the partial run.
recovery_amendment.selection: No outcome-based retries or candidate selection. The same planned seeds and arms are required.

training_summary.performance_evaluation: Not performed by this training command; use separate fixed-scenario evaluations.

incomplete_attempt.interpretation: Registered one-hour wall limit was crossed during a verified local sleep/hibernate interruption. The saved checkpoint is internally consistent but has only 13481 live transitions. It is not a completed performance trial.
